visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with maroon-dyed hair and a dark headband stands in a modern kitchen environment, smiling and talking to the camera. She holds a large circular wooden plaque that displays a professional family portrait of a couple, three children, and a golden retriever. She wears a cream-colored sweatshirt with a red panda graphic and the word 'UNAHI'. The background features a kitchen counter, a stove, and shelves filled with various figurines and collectibles. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of the kitchen counter where the woman is performing a DIY task. She uses a metal ruler and a pencil to mark a square on the wooden back of the plaque. She then utilizes a woodcarving chisel and a wooden mallet to carefully carve out a hole in the center. The movements are precise as she taps the mallet repeatedly. Small pieces of wood shavings accumulate on the surface around the plaque. (3) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman as she holds the completed project. She has successfully installed a black clock mechanism into the newly carved hole and attached black hour/minute hands and a thin yellow second hand over the family photo. She demonstrates the functionality by showing the back, where a battery is inserted into the casing. (4) In the final sequence, the clock is shown hung on a grey, textured interior wall next to a silver YouTube award plaque and a decorative Mickey Mouse figure. Animated heart icons, golden sparkles, and colorful firework graphics appear around the clock on the screen to celebrate the successful transformation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a cheerful female narration in Traditional Chinese, explaining the purpose of the video. Her voice is clear, friendly, and exhibits moderate arousal. A background pop song featuring acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum rhythm plays concurrently, providing a warm and domestic atmosphere. (2) A transition occurs where the narration ceases, and the prominent acoustic sound of a wooden mallet striking a chisel is heard. These rhythmic 'thuds' have a short spectral bandwidth and occur in quick succession, emphasizing the physical effort of the carving process. The BGM continues smoothly throughout this segment. (3) The female narrator returns with an increased pitch and more animated delivery as she reveals the finished clock. Her tone is triumphant and positive. A subtle 'ding' sound effect might be perceived as the final product is showcased. The BGM, featuring a male singer, swells slightly as the video concludes with an upbeat musical finish.
